name: Sakutto Panda ~Mousou Koukyoukyoku~
original_name: さくっとパンダ ～妄想交響曲～
source:
It has been one a year since Kotatsu parted with her trainer. She leads a normal life and goes to a part-time job every day. But past reminds of itself anew, and by a twist of fate fighting and delusional maidens intervene in her life again.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
小辰与训练师分手已经一年了。她过着正常的生活，每天都去做兼职。但过去的事再次提醒自己，命运的转折使战斗和妄想的少女再次介入她的生活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
